name: Fairy Tale Adventure
source:
In short, this game is a roleplaying adult game that takes place in the fairy tale universe. It follows an original character in his quest to become tje ruler of every single land in the fairy tale world. As you travel, you meet and befriend famous characters such as Rumplestiltskin, Alice from the wonderland story, Jack from the beanstalk story and many more. You also meet and and have the option to romance and/or capture all the fairy tale princesses.

[From [URL=https://www.patreon.com/Masquerade]Patreon[/URL]]

Further development of the game has been abandoned.
translation:
简单来说，这是一款以童话世界为背景的成人角色扮演游戏。故事跟随一名原创角色，讲述他为成为整个童话世界每一片土地的统治者而展开的冒险。旅途中，你将遇见并结交许多知名角色，例如侏儒怪、《爱丽丝梦游仙境》中的爱丽丝、《杰克与魔豆》中的杰克，等等。你也会遇见各位童话公主，并可以选择追求她们，或将她们俘获，亦或两者兼有。

[摘自[URL=https://www.patreon.com/Masquerade]Patreon[/URL]]

本作已停止后续开发。
